snippet.title: Thunder Fox Longplay (Arcade) [QHD]
snippet.description:
Game Info
---------------------------------------------------
Developer: Taito
Publisher: Taito
Year of Release: 1990

Game Review & Impressions
---------------------------------------------------
If you're looking for a dose of adrenaline-fueled machismo, Taito has just the game for you. Thunder Fox espouses all the trappings of the classic 80s action flick: bulging muscles; explosions; more military-grade hardware than even John Matrix could handle comfortably. In terms of gameplay, this is another run-and-gun side-scroller in the mould of Rolling Thunder, Shinobi, and a good dollop of Sly Spy for good measure. It's not especially remarkable, but the overall presentation is excellent, and the gameplay is solid - collect guns and other power-ups to overcome legions of adversaries the game throws at you, with each stage culminating in the typical boss fight players should be well versed with.
